checks.name: append_only_overhead_suite
checks.target: dedicated append-only-overhead report; stress/PPS fixtures are not interchangeable

checks.name: fixture_binding
checks.target: report fixture fingerprint equals the readiness evidence fingerprint

checks.name: source_binding
checks.target: report revision and source fingerprint match the current checkout

checks.name: three_fixed_repeats
checks.target: baseline_v1 and balanced_v1 each run both scenarios exactly three times

checks.name: offline_evidence_identity
checks.target: fixed-action data remains deterministic/fake and never claims provider-reported usage

checks.name: fixed_actions
checks.target: each baseline/candidate pair uses the same fixed action fingerprint

checks.name: structured_working_memory
checks.target: balanced_v1 uses structured_v1 with zero opaque working blobs

checks.name: single_item_update_stream
checks.target: 100 updates publish no unrelated working entries, including read_file insertion

checks.name: prefix_and_recovery
checks.target: ordinary/compression prefix invariants and checkpoint recovery pass

checks.name: new_memory_token_reduction
checks.target: combined estimated new-memory tokens decrease by at least 50%

checks.name: compression_call_reduction
checks.target: no scenario increases compressions and combined calls decrease by at least 25%

checks.name: estimated_input_nonincrease
checks.target: combined total estimated input does not increase

checks.name: bounded_validation_only
checks.target: readiness authorizes bounded validation only, not PPS benefit or rollout
